removedIn names the step (S1/S2/S3/S6) whose migration list explicitly replaces that line; null means the site is outside this run scope entirely (S1 to S7 do not touch it) and is left for the Redline C1 icon-set follow-up named in the spec Follow-ups section.

The spec text for this fixture (S0 section) says it should be seeded with one entry, a size={172} avatar preview -- that prop is on <AssistantAvatar>, not a <Feather> element, so it never matches this scan and is intentionally not listed (see the S0 delivery report).

glass-standard.feature scenario 4 fails if a Feather size literal outside ICON appears at a file:line:size not in this list, so a new non-ICON literal is still caught even though the pre-existing backlog is not.

Keyed on file + size + count, not line: every step of this adoption edits these files, and renumbering an allowlist by hand is how a genuine new offender gets waved through as 'just the numbers moving again'. The count is the teeth — one more literal of the same size in the same file fails the scenario even though the file is grandfathered.

QA round 1: the scan matched <Feather ... size={N} .../> per LINE, so a tag whose size={N} sits on a different line than <Feather> (idiomatic multi-line RN/Prettier formatting) matched nothing — not flagged AND not counted against the count below. Fixed to scan whole-file text instead of per line; three entries below carry a 'reason' because their true count was always higher than what this file recorded, or (IncludeArchivedToggle.tsx) they were missing from this list entirely.

QA round 2: the tag scan still stopped at the first '>' after <Feather (hidden by a quoted attribute containing '>') and still only matched a literal digit, so size={someVar}/size={ICON.lg + 4}/size={20 as number} produced zero matches — not flagged, not counted. Fixed with a quote/brace-aware tag scan plus a modest evaluator that resolves plain integers, ICON.sm/md/lg references (pulled from the real assets.ts export) and simple +-*/ arithmetic over them, with a trailing 'as Type' stripped. Anything that evaluator can't resolve is now a COMPUTED match, checked against 'computedEntries' below (keyed on file + exact expression text, not a size) instead of being silently skipped.

entries.reason: QA round 1: :409-411 is a multi-line <Feather size={16}> the line-only scan couldn't see (true count was always 3, not 2) — cross-newline scan fix, no icon size changed.
QA round 1: :327-329 is a multi-line <Feather size={13}> the line-only scan couldn't see (true count was always 2, not 1) — cross-newline scan fix, no icon size changed.

QA round 1: :47-51 is a multi-line <Feather size={13}> — was never in this list at all, invisible to the line-only scan before the cross-newline fix. Grandfathered same as the rest of this list, awaiting the Redline C1 icon-set pass.

computedEntries.reason: QA round 2: onboarding icon scales with the card's own `size` prop rather than a fixed ICON value, by construction off-scale at most sizes — was completely unguarded before the computed-size fix (previously zero matches, not an allowlisted pass).

glyphSize is `ICON.lg` for size="lg" or `ICON.md` for size="md" (see the ternary a few lines above each Feather) — both on-scale, but the guard only resolves what's written directly inside the size={…} expression itself, not a local variable's definition elsewhere in the file.

QA round 3: `ICON_SIZE` is now `= ICON.md` (was a bare `18` — same value, but a coincidental duplicate rather than a reference to the token; fixed since the guard's report should describe the real code, not a stale magic number). Still unresolvable for the same reason as glyphSize above: the guard only resolves what's written directly inside size={…}, not a local constant's own definition elsewhere in the file.
